identification: Set of 10 Murano (Venetian) vaseline/uranium glass stemware, c.1920s-50s: 3 coupes (champagne/cocktail) with spiral-ribbed pale yellow-green uranium bowl and foot and a pink/rose aventurine (gold-fleck) dolphin stem with black-dot eyes on a uranium knop; and 7 tall conical goblets/vases in pale green uranium glass with a gold-foil (aventurine) ribbed knop and plain foot. Coupe glows bright green under UV in photo 2; goblet glows in photo 3. This dolphin-stem coupe form is the classic Salviati/Venice & Murano Glass Co type and was made by several Murano firms (Salviati, Cenedese, Toso). Unmarked, which is normal for Salviati table glass (paper labels only). So: Salviati-TYPE Murano, not provable as Salviati.
